query_snapshot: Which alloy and heat-treatment conditions does NASA SP-8119 identify as susceptible to stress corrosion in its material-compatibility discussion?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119 states that materials susceptible to stress corrosion should not be used. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- Alloy 2014-T4 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- Alloy 2024-T3 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- Alloy 2024-T4 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- Alloy 2024-T351 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- Alloy PH15-7Mo in conditions RH950 and TH1050 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- Alloy 17-7PH in the annealed condition is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- Alloy 17-7PH in condition H900 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- Alloy 17-4PH is included in the list of materials identified as susceptible to stress corrosion (the heat-treatment identifiers adjacent to 17-4PH in the source OCR are garbled and not legible). [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- Alloy AM350 in condition SCT850 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- Alloy AM355 in condition SCT850 is listed as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
